summary: Improve role profiles, structured interviews, and fair selection records. Explore this five-day hiring and selection training course.
lede: Recruitment training helps managers turn role requirements into consistent, evidence-based hiring decisions. For line managers, HR practitioners and talent acquisition specialists, it covers job analysis, competency criteria, structured interviews and STAR-based scoring. Participants also practise planning work-sample assessments, documenting selection decisions, reviewing recruitment measures in Excel and applying human oversight to AI-assisted screening.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape hiring decisions, assess candidates, or oversee recruitment controls. It suits managers with some exposure to recruitment who want a consistent process grounded in job evidence and practical documentation.
prerequisites: Recommended: experience supervising staff or contributing to recruitment decisions. No coding or programming is required. Excel access is useful for the optional recruitment dashboard exercise.
